# EventBliss

> EventBliss is the all-in-one event planning app for bachelor parties (JGA), bachelorette celebrations, birthdays, group trips, and weddings. Available as web app, iOS, and Android. Plan events, invite crews via code, play 24+ party games, split expenses automatically, and browse 147+ activity ideas across 38 European JGA cities.

EventBliss is operated by MYFAMBLISS GROUP LTD (Cyprus). The platform is free to use with optional Premium features. The product is available in 10 languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, and Arabic. The primary market is DACH (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) with growing international reach.

## Core Features

- [Event Creation](https://event-bliss.com/create): Create events in seconds with smart templates
- [Join Event](https://event-bliss.com/join): Join via invite code, no account required
- [Games Hub](https://event-bliss.com/games): 24+ party games (Taboo, Truth or Dare, Bottle Spin, Impostor, Heads Up, more) — offline single device or online multiplayer up to 30 players
- [Ideas Hub](https://event-bliss.com/ideas): 183 categorized activities + 56 theme suggestions
- [Marketplace](https://event-bliss.com/marketplace): Booking JGA service providers
- [JGA Budget Calculator](https://event-bliss.com/jga/kalkulator): Free tool to estimate JGA costs per person across 38 European cities

City-specific guides for bachelor parties in major European destinations, each with activities, neighborhoods, budget breakdown, insider tips, and FAQs.

### DACH Region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland)

- [JGA Berlin](https://event-bliss.com/jga/berlin): Bachelor party in Berlin — clubs, Spree boat tours, kart racing

- [JGA München](https://event-bliss.com/jga/muenchen): Biergarten culture, Wiesn (Oktoberfest), Englischer Garten
- [JGA Köln](https://event-bliss.com/jga/koeln): Brauhaus tour, Karneval, Belgian Quarter bars
- [JGA Frankfurt](https://event-bliss.com/jga/frankfurt): Skyline rooftops, Sachsenhausen Apfelwein-Meile
- [JGA Stuttgart](https://event-bliss.com/jga/stuttgart): Karting capital, Cannstatter Volksfest, Weinberge
- [JGA Düsseldorf](https://event-bliss.com/jga/duesseldorf): Altbier-Tour, longest bar in the world, Medienhafen
- [JGA Wien](https://event-bliss.com/jga/wien): Heuriger, Donauinsel, imperial culture mixed with underground
- [JGA Zürich](https://event-bliss.com/jga/zuerich): Limmat swimming, Alpine day trips, Langstrasse bars
- [JGA Hannover](https://event-bliss.com/jga/hannover): Steintor bar mile, Schützenfest (largest fair in world)
- [JGA Dresden](https://event-bliss.com/jga/dresden): Neustadt 200+ bars, Frauenkirche, Elbe SUP
- [JGA Leipzig](https://event-bliss.com/jga/leipzig): Karli bar mile, Cospudener See, alternative culture
- [JGA Nürnberg](https://event-bliss.com/jga/nuernberg): Franconian beer, Burg, Christkindlesmarkt
- [JGA Salzburg](https://event-bliss.com/jga/salzburg): Alpine day trips, Mozart culture, festival town

## Common JGA Questions (concise factual answers)

**What does a JGA cost per person?** A weekend JGA realistically costs 230–1000 € per person depending on the destination. DACH cities average 350–550 €. Cheapest options: Bucharest, Tallinn, Krakow, Warsaw from 180 €. Premium: Zurich, Ibiza, London 700–1000 €.

**What is the cheapest JGA city in Europe?** Bucharest, Tallinn, Krakow, and Warsaw from 180 € per person for 3 nights including flight. In Germany: Leipzig, Dresden, Hannover from 220 €.

**Which city has the best stag-do infrastructure?** Prague is the most-booked JGA destination in Europe due to price (beer 2–3 €), bar density, activity infrastructure, and 90-minute flights from DACH. Dublin and Edinburgh have the most developed stag-do culture historically.

**How early should we book?** For May–September peak season: 8–12 weeks lead time for accommodations and popular activities. Festival dates (Oktoberfest, Cannstatter Volksfest, Karneval, Las Fallas, St. Patrick's Day): 6–9 months ahead.

**Hotel or AirBnB for a JGA group?** From 6+ people, AirBnB is almost always more economical (own pre-party location, no curfew, often half the hotel price). Under 6 people, hostels work. 8+ people: AirBnB strongly recommended.
